title: Custom Quiz Builder (iPad Landscape)
prompt:
Tablet screen, iPad Pro 11 in landscape (1194x834), dark OLED, iPadOS-native feel. App "NY RE Exam": a one-person study app for the New York State real estate salesperson exam. Design system "Wayfinding" (already applied to this project): New York transit signage language, not nostalgia. Canvas #090d16, surface cards #111725, raised controls #182033, 1px hairlines rgba(148,163,184,.16) only where they group things, primary text #f1f5f9, secondary text #a3b1c6, go green #10b981 for the primary action and selected states. Headings in Helvetica Neue bold, sentence case, tight tracking -0.02em; UI text in SF Pro, 17px body, 15px secondary, 13px meta, tabular numbers. Radii: 24 sheets, 18 cards, 14 controls, full pills for bullets. 40px screen gutters. Never use all-caps labels, middle-dot separators, or arrows on buttons. Elevation through surface lightness, not shadows.

Screen: the custom quiz builder re-flowed for a landscape tablet, designed like planning a subway trip on a wall map: pick your lines (topics) on the left, then the trip settings and the Go button on the right. Everything fits on one screen without scrolling.

Top: large-title header "Custom quiz" (34px Helvetica Neue bold) with a secondary line "286 questions match" under it, left aligned with the content. No back arrow, no tab bar on this screen.

Two-pane layout below the header, 32px apart:

Left pane (about 62% width): heading "Topics" with "12 of 19" in secondary text, two quiet text buttons "All" and "None" on the right. Below it one surface card holding a strip map laid out in TWO side-by-side columns of subway lines (like a transit strip map poster). Each row is a 44px station: a 26px circular route bullet (bold single character, line color) + the topic name + a small question count right-aligned + a check mark when selected. Within each line a 4px vertical line in the line's color runs through the centers of the bullets connecting them like stations; 12px gap between lines. Unselected rows: hollow ring bullet in the line color, name in secondary color, no check. Left column: red line (1 License Law & Article 12-A, 2 Law of Agency, 3 Human Rights & Fair Housing), green line (4 Real Estate Finance, 5 Valuation & Market Analysis, 6 Real Estate Math), blue line (A Legal Issues & Land Title, C Estates & Encumbrances, E Real Estate Contracts). Right column: orange line with dark glyphs (B Land Use Regulations, D Municipal Agencies, F Construction & Environment, M Property Insurance), yellow line with dark glyphs (N Taxes & Assessments, Q Closing & Settlement, R Commercial Real Estate, W Property Management), purple line (7 Condos & Co-ops), lime line with dark glyph (G Rentals & Deal Sheets). Show Real Estate Math, the whole yellow line, and Condos & Co-ops unselected.

Right pane (about 38% width, an inspector column that stays pinned while the map scrolls): section "Questions" with an iOS segmented control 10, 25, 50, 75 (75 selected with a lighter raised thumb) and beside it a compact number field captioned "Custom". Section "Mode": two side-by-side selectable cards, "Tutor" (book icon, instant feedback with the legal citation after every answer) and "Timed exam" (clock icon, answers hidden until you submit, 90:00 on the clock); Timed exam is selected with a 2px go-green ring and a small filled go-green check. Section "Question pool": a four-segment control with label over count (All 286, Unseen 214, Bookmarked 6, Mistakes 14; All selected). Then a grouped card with two iOS switches, both on: "Shuffle question order" and "Shuffle answer positions (A-D)".

Bottom right, aligned exactly under the right pane and the same width: a floating glass capsule action bar (translucent #111725 with blur, 1px hairline border, 26px radius) holding a raised pill with a clock icon and "90:00" in tabular Helvetica Neue bold, and one 56px go-green button "Start 75-question exam" with dark text. The left pane has no action bar under it.
